title: Chat: Chat/set and Message/set identical values
description: Template: jmap_server::check_read_only_patch / strip_read_only_patch (crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs) as used in mail (8a4d5b74 rewritten; git log --grep 'bd: JMAP-t8ej.25.1'). RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Mark's decisions (on JMAP-t8ej.27 notes): {} and identical-only patches are a no-op success (updated {id:null}, no write, state unchanged); unknown-only patches and empty structural arrays stay errors. ORDER (lesson from t8ej.26): existence -> permission/closed-state/forbidden gates -> read-only check -> no-op exit. One test per handler, oracle the RFC/spec text. jmap-chat-server chat.rs and message.rs reject every server-set/immutable key via their bad_props allow-lists, even when identical to the stored value. Switch them to the shared helper with the stored object, keeping their existing permission gates first.
